name: Minor Thunderclap Monastery
feature: Maitreya Buddha's stone-chime page descended to earth; the false Thunderclap Monastery is the largest in scale.

name: Lion-Camel Cave
owner: Azure Lion · White Elephant · Great Roc
feature: A three-demon-king conglomerate; a whole kingdom of demon atmosphere on an unprecedented scale.

name: Lotus Cave on Flat-Top Mountain
owner: Golden Horn King · Silver Horn King
feature: Lord Lao's pill-refining page boys descended to earth, with the most lavish magical-treasure setup.

name: Plantain Cave of Emerald-Cloud Mountain
owner: Princess Iron Fan · Bull Demon King
feature: Owned by the Rākṣasī; her fan quenched the great fire of Flaming Mountain.

name: Jade-Wave Pool of Boulder Mountain
owner: Nine-Headed Son-in-Law · Dragon King of Ten Thousand Saints
feature: A dragon-palace-style cave-mansion; the Princess of Ten Thousand Saints stole the Buddha's śarīra relic.

name: Jindou Cave
feature: Lord Lao's green ox descended to earth; the Diamond Snare snared away all the gods' weapons.

name: Cloud-Touching Cave of Thunder-Hoard Mountain
feature: The Bull Demon King's mistress's residence, the legacy of the “Ten-Thousand-Year Fox King.”

name: Nine-Curve Winding Cave
feature: The nine-headed lion mount of the Heavenly Venerable Taiyi, “Nine-Spirits Primordial Sage” commands the demons.

name: Water Curtain Cave
feature: A heaven-born stone cave where the Great Sage Equaling Heaven rose to power.

name: Fire-Cloud Cave of Mount Hao
feature: Son of the Bull Demon King, a juvenile demon king who can unleash True Samadhi Fire.

name: Bottomless Cave of Sunken-Empty Mountain
feature: Sworn daughter of the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li; she stole the crystal lamp oil at Spirit Mountain.

name: Dark-Splendor Cave of Green-Dragon Mountain
feature: Three rhinoceros demons disguised as the Buddha to steal perfumed oil, consuming fifty thousand jin a year.

name: Black Wind Cave
feature: A rare “Chan-practicing” type among demon kings, able to discuss the Way and expound scriptures.

name: Turtle Mansion of the Tongtian River
feature: A goldfish from Guanyin's lotus pond that demands boys and girls to eat.

name: Qinghua Manor
owner: Deer Demon · State Preceptor of the Bhikṣu Kingdom
feature: The white deer mount of the Old Man of the South Pole descended to earth, intending to use 1,111 children's hearts and livers.

name: Yellow Wind Cave
feature: A yellow-furred marten that attained the Way at the foot of Spirit Mountain, with ties to the Buddhist order.

name: Wave-Moon Cave
feature: Kui Wood Wolf of the Heavenly Court descended to earth and took the “princess,” the daughter of the King of Precious Elephant Kingdom, as his wife.

name: Pipa Cave
feature: A venomous Scorpion Demon that stung the Buddha and whom even Guanyin dares not approach.

name: Silk-Web Cave
feature: Seven sisters live together, fellow disciples of the Hundred-Eyed Demon of Yellow-Flower Monastery.

name: Linked-Circle Cave of Hidden-Mist Mountain
feature: A hidden leopard of the Southern Mountains who used the “Plum-Blossom Splitting” scheme to feign defeat against Wukong.

name: Rabbit Warren of Mount Maoying
feature: The Jade Rabbit of the Moon Palace, who sought to take Tang Sanzang as her mate.

name: Rotten-Persimmon Lane
feature: A great python that has not cultivated a human form; “Rotten-Persimmon Lane” is unbearably foul.
